properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for DevCenter: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier protects against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss for DevCenter workloads. Maps to CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001 Annex A.10 (cryptography) and A.12 (operations).

metadata.policyName: Microsoft Dev Box Pools should not use Microsoft Hosted Networks.
